96 object VariableHelper {
97   /**
98    * creates a variable.  The expr is set with 'set var' allowing queries, the default is null.
99    *
100    * NB declare or replace is used.
101    *
102    * @param stableName
103    * @param ddl
104    */
105   def createVar(stableName: String, ddl: String, expr: String): Unit = {
106     // Defaults can't have subqueries
107     val defaultCommand = s"declare or replace variable `$stableName` $ddl default null;"
108     SparkSession.active.sql(defaultCommand)
109     val setCommand = s"set var `$stableName` = $expr;"
110     SparkSession.active.sql(setCommand)
111   }
112 }

116   def rowTypedEnc(rowType: DataType): TypedEncoder[Row] =
117     new TypedEncoder[Row]()(ClassTag(classOf[Row])) {
118       override def nullable: Boolean = agnosticEncoder.nullable
119 
120       override val agnosticEncoder: AgnosticEncoder[Row] = ShimUtils.rowEncoder(rowType.asInstanceOf[StructType])
121     }
